content.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 launches Starlink 10-33
content.text: Launch window: March 19th from 6:35AM to 10:35AM EDT (10:35-14:35 UTC) Current T0: March 19th at 10:20:30AM EDT (14:20:30 UTC) Mission: Falcon 9 launch of 29 Starlink v2 Mini satellites into orbit. Launch location: Space Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40), Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Earth. Target orbit: Low-Earth Orbit (LEO); 256x269km 53.16º orbit Booster: B1077-27; 27d 8h 56min 50s turnaround Past customer missions: Crew-5, GPS-III SV06, Inmarsat-6 F2, CRS-28, Galaxy 37, NG-20, Optus-X. Past Starlink missions: 5-10, 6-13, 6-25, 6-33, 6-43, 6-51, 6-63, 10-4, 8-11, 6-71, 12-18, 12-25, 12-23, 12-19, 10-28, 10-14, 10-21, 6-95, 10-36. Satellites launched: 508, will be 537 after this mission. Booster recovery: Just Read The Instructions (JRTI) Fairing recovery: Bob Rocket trajectory: Northeast flying parallel to the US east coast Payload mass: Approximately 17 tonnes. Stats: SpaceX's 644th launch overall. SpaceX's 35th launch of the year. SpaceX's 10th launch of the month. Earth's 60th orbital launch of the year. Falcon's 264th launch since the last failure. Falcon 9's 616th orbital flight. SpaceX's 317th launch from SLC-40. 152nd landing on JRTI out of 153 attempts. 247th successful landing by a Falcon booster since the last failed one. SpaceX's 370th launch dedicated to Starlink and the 43rd Group 10 mission. ⚡ Become a member of NASASpaceflight's channel for exclusive discord access, fast turnaround clips, and other exclusive benefits.
